remarks: What a pristine beautiful home!  Ready to move in!  Freshly painted from top to bottom.  Loads of fabulous living space and yard for all to enjoy!  The home includes a beautiful sunroom next to the huge flagstone patio, and huge newer kitchen next to the best ever great room above the garage - the owners used it for doing their oil paintings!  The living area includes a fabulous formal dining room, next to a formal living room with fireplace, next to a HUGE family room with a fireplace...  A bedroom on the first floor with full bath.  Three bedrooms upstairs - 2 of them could be primary bedrooms...one with 2 walk-in closets and a fireplace and attached full bath - the other with 1 walk-in closet and a full bath.  HUGE open lower level with a half bath and full toolroom.  In addition to the attached 2 car garage, there is a large barn for cars or just storage!
